answer_1.quote: ...we evaluate Gated DeltaNet-E8 on LongBench, a specialized benchmark designed for long-context understanding. The maximum context length in LongBench is up to 64k tokens. The results of the scaled RNN models are presented in Table . Our findings indicate that expanding the state size of RNN models consistently enhances performance across tasks. Specifically, Gated DeltaNet-E8 achieves an average improvement of 5.74% compared to the baseline model... LongBench includes tasks such as Narrative QA, QasperQA, MultiField QA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMulti QA, Musique, GovReport, QMSum, MultiNews, TRec, Trivia QA, SamSum, LCC, and RepoBench-P.
